DIAGNOSIS READY: Familial Chondrocalcinosis (Pseudogout)

The repeated normal readings for inflammatory markers and structural measurements suggest a non-septic, non-degenerative crystal arthropathy. Given the strong family history and the isolated nature of the swelling, this is most consistent with Familial Chondrocalcinosis.
